text: All right, so the timeline view in the left side of this AI dashboard, I think we'll want the grid to be full screen. The lines anyway should go full left to right. The scroll bar should also be full height. So we need this AI V3 page to be full bleed, and then each column will have padding. That should probably be like section padding. Look at the padding tokens we have. I don't know if the default padding is going to be enough. Actually, it might. It should. Go with default padding, see what it looks like. I want to see two equal columns. The left side will have the grid lines with timestamps, the every hour, for example, should be marked on the timeline so that we can roughly have spatial reasoning about it. We put the timestamp for each card above the card and on the line that represents its actual time. So it's very precise. I think it can just be floating there. Or maybe the times go in the margin to the left. I don't know yet. We'll figure that out. Maybe just put the time outside the card for now. The temporal awareness should become natural. It's not super important to know exactly what time everything happened. It's more seeing a flow and seeing what's current and whatnot.
